subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as core TUI config, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK/rendering seam, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses public config, TUI rendering, provider usage/auth, and Plugin SDK boundaries; automation can show the gaps but cannot safely choose the long-term product/API contract.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Use the PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage fields only after ordering, truncation, caching, and credential policy are approved.

options.title: Core config template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui` footer template/config surface and accept the compatibility, docs, schema, and migration burden for a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep existing status surfaces
options.body: Leave `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and menu-bar usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and reject persistent footer customization for now.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Use the PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage fields only after ordering, truncation, caching, and credential policy are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans provider usage/cost reporting and the plugin architecture boundary needed for this decision.
